condition.narrative: FA and GA, Section I.A.C.1 and 2. The Recipient, through the MOH, shall ensure that the Project is carried out in accordance withthe Environmental and Social Standards, and the Environmental and Social Commitment Plan (“ESCP”), in a manner acceptable to theAssociation, including in respect to all bidding documents and contracts for civil works under the Project, and the use of militaryor security forces in the implementation of Project activities.

FA, Section I.A.E; GA, Section I.D. All activities carried out by military or security forces under the Project shall be under thecontrol of the MOH and shall be undertaken exclusively for the purposes related to the Project; all goods, works, services,incremental operating costs, and training financed by the Credit proceeds may be used by military or security forces under thedirection and control of the MOH and strictly in accordance with the Project Operations Manual and other arrangements or protocolsthat the Association may require for carrying out these activities; and except as the Association may otherwise agree, theRecipient, through the MOH, shall ensure that that the ownership of any assets generated, goods procured, and works constructed bymilitary or security forces out of the Credit proceeds shall be transferred to, or shall vest, with the MOH or any equivalent orappropriate line ministry or agency agreed with the Association.
FA, Section I.A.F. All Project COVID-19 Vaccines shall satisfy the Vaccine Approval Criteria.

Financing Agreement (FA) and HEPR Grant Agreement (GA), Section I.A.1. The Recipient, through the MOH, shall carry out the Projectin accordance with this Agreement, the Project Operations Manual and the Vaccine Delivery and Distribution Manual.

Schedule 2, Section B.1: Project Operations Manual. Not later than one month after the Effective Date, the Recipient, through theMinistry of Health, shall prepare, adopt and thereafter carry out, the Project in accordance with an operations manual acceptableto the International Development Association (IDA).
